notes.title: PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
####update content####
1.Added three input schemes to choose from to meet the key preferences of different players.(feature button is in the upper right corner of the Ark room)
2. Optimized the underlying logic of the input system
3. Adjust the volume of some voices
4. Optimize some Hscene performance
5. Add "Hscene skip" function
6. Looking back Hscene in Gallery will not force end after "shooting"
7. Adjusted to be able to run in the background
8. Attempt to fix some problems with a small probability


The game has been released for almost a week, thank you very much for your support!
We have carried out more functional updates that everyone cares about. We'll do our best to make the game better and give you a wonderful time.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
### New Functions Added
- Added "Voice Replay" function
- Added the ability to return to the Ark at any time when replaying the animation Hscene in Gallery

### Bug Fixes
Replace some incorrect image resources
Fixed an issue where the word order of some Chinese voices of Eleanor was incorrect
Fixed the issue that holding down Ctrl to fast forward does not work in some cases
Fixed the problem that the Hscene slider can be pulled

notes.title: Ark Mobius is now officially released! ! !
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we are YellowDuck Works. Our first work Ark Mobius is officially released today.

It's on sale for 10% off in the first week, don't miss it! ! !


We would love to see you sharing your gaming experiences in the community.
And if you encounter any problems during the game, you can tell us in the community, e-mail us, or comment/reply us on Twitter @YellowduckWork, we will reply as soon as possible.
We'll do our best to make the game better and give you a wonderful time.

Hope you enjoy our game.

YellowDuck Works
